_what: Note onsets (tick:MIDI numbers joined by +) read from the Mutopia MIDI file of Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2 (Mutopia-2014/12/18-1590, SHA-256 e202d3941ce5f26397f57f59f0e2e4e3ad9e19061fa3c4dc596c5ee6a6a2548e), pickup and bars 1 to 4, scaled from 384 to 480 ticks per quarter. LilyPond produced the MIDI from the same source, so it resolves every relative octave independently of the hand transcription. Tied continuations have no onset.
